name: Black Art:  Thousand Futures On Borrowed Time

sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu (Tactile), Fuinjutsu, Yin Release

system.description:
(As a part of the casting of this Jutsu you must have the Miraigan active.) Every possible future you have glimpsed has been saved within the confines of your Miraigan, unleased in a wave of Yin Chakra, crashing over the minds of every hostile creature in range forcing them to see every possibility, every causality and every timeline you have seen before. They must make a Wisdom saving throw as they fight against the overwhelming weight of what could be.

Critical Success: Affected creatures is able to resist this jutsu’s effects.

Success: Affected creature is Confused for the duration, remaking their saving throws at the end of each of their turns.

Failure: Affected creature is Confused and Staggered for the duration, remaking their saving throws at the end of each of their turns, ending this effect on a success.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but they are also Dazed due to the mental strain.
